instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Scheduler: from recurring schedules (every day or week at a local time in a time zone, daylight saving handled) and one-off timed actions, work out what is due to run now and the next time to run", and give it now (The time to work from: ISO text or epoch milliseconds).
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:when-to-run-next and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give now plus schedules (schedule_id, timezone as an IANA name, start_local_date, cadence {unit: day | week, interval?, weekdays?: 0=Sunday..6}, local_window {start: HH:MM, duration_minutes}, dst {gap: skip | next-valid, fold: earlier | later | both}, action with its owner_dispatch) and their occurrence_states, and/or one-off time_windows, actions and receipts.
